package.description: A local-first Agent workspace where tools, permissions, artifacts, and durable progress stay visible.

en-US.description: A local-first Agent workspace where tools, permissions, artifacts, and durable progress stay visible.
en-US.longDescription: Maka is a local-first AI desktop assistant that does more than answer questions. With controlled permissions, it can inspect projects, execute tools, produce artifacts, and preserve model messages, tool calls, and durable-task progress as recoverable execution facts. Sessions, settings, and run records stay on your machine by default; you choose the model connection — a cloud API, a local model, or a compatible gateway. The same Runtime is available through the desktop app, terminal TUI, non-interactive CLI, and Headless runner.
en-US.name: Maka

zh-CN.description: 一个本地优先的 Agent 工作台：工具、权限、产物和可恢复的进度全程保持可见。
zh-CN.longDescription: Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 桌面助手，它不只回答问题。在受控权限下，它可以检查项目、执行工具、生成产物，并把模型消息、工具调用和长程任务进度保存为可恢复的运行事实。会话、设置与运行记录默认保存在本机；模型连接由你选择——云 API、本地模型或兼容网关。桌面应用、终端 TUI、非交互 CLI 与 Headless runner 使用同一套 Runtime。
